narr: A Pacific storm system brought heavy rain and snow to the Spring Mountains and their eastern foothills.
ev: Highway 159 was closed due to flooding.
lsr: RTC SOUTHERN NEVADA REPORTS SR159 CLOSED DUE TO WATER OVER THE ROADWAYS, CONFIRMED PICTURES OF WATER OVER THE ROAD BY LOCAL MEDIA. ROAD CLOSED 720 AM, REOPENED 1207 PM.
